messages:
Maya: FYI — prepping SLA evidence pack for Meridian Health renewal. Need final uptime/latency numbers and any credit calculations we promised.
Helen: timeline?
Maya: customer kickoff next Wed. Want comms draft by EOD Tue.
Jesse (AE): I'll pull contract notes. We promised 99.9% uptime, need to confirm latency targets (I think p95 < 500ms).
Arun (SRE): quick snapshot — our p50 is ~120ms, p95 ~420ms during peak. There was a Jan incident that cost ~30m downtime (I'll export windows).
Maya: perfect. Can you attach the export to the thread? also need the credit calc per SLA (what the contract says we owe).
Jesse (AE): Contract has tiers — will paste exact clause.
Jesse (AE): ```
SLA Section 4.2: Monthly Uptime Percentage and Credits
- >=99.9%: No credit
- >=99.0% and <99.9%: 5% credit
- <99.0%: 10% credit
```
Arun (SRE): summary from infra: monthly uptime for Feb window = 99.88% (including that incident). I'll prepare uptime.csv and incident summary (sensitive logs will be DM'd).
Maya: 99.88% => that maps to 5% credit. Need finance calc against their Feb invoice. @elliot_cs can you run the dollar amount?
elliot_cs: on it. Need invoice ID and amount.
Helen: invoice ID INV-74321 for Feb, amount billed $130,000.
elliot_cs: thanks — preliminary credit = $6,500 (5% of $130k). I'll confirm with accounting and post final by EOD.
Maya: thanks. Also want a short customer-facing explainer: cause, mitigation steps, and what we've changed to reduce risk. @Arun can you draft 3 bullets for mitigation and timeline?
Arun (SRE): sure — bullets: 1) autoscale policy tightened for region bursts (deploy in 48h), 2) KV cache pre-warm during deploy windows to reduce cold-starts, 3) enable cross-region circuit-breaker to failover gracefully.
product-ops: I'll draft a one-page runbook for the customer recommending retry/backoff and idempotency patterns.
Maya: owners recap: arun — technical export + mitigation bullets; jesse — contract excerpt; elliot_cs — finance credit calc; product-ops — comms/runbook. I'll assemble the evidence pack Tue noon and share for review.
Jesse (AE): ack.
elliot_cs: ack, will confirm number by 16:00 PST.
Maya: small request — when uploading files to drive, please prefix filenames with "evidence-pack/meridian/" and add the tag "evidence-pack" in the comment.
SLA-bot: Reminder: uploaded files older than 90 days will be archived automatically.
Maya: noted :thumbsup:
